title: Affine and geometric data for chosen residue maps
statement:
For the finite family in the chosen geometric maps theorem, package one source affine residue comparison, one target comparison, one chain representative per index, and the common geometric fibre comparisons into a single `Nonempty` structure. The structure records the affine and geometric compatibility equations used by the enclosing theorem.

proof.text: Apply the affine residue data theorem to choose eK, eC and φ with the derived-fibre map equation.
Apply picard_derived_fibre_naturality to choose e and ei for the common source and all targets, then package its geometric equations with the affine data.
